summary: Backend-only regression for the new SOLO CHOREOGRAPHER LIBRARY feature. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_solo_choreographer_library.py — 30 tests across 6 classes covering the parser edge cases, BootStepper _normalise multi-name preservation, POST/PUT/GET /api/dances splitting, GET /api/choreographers library exclusion of co-only people, GET /api/dances?q= matching on co_choreographers, and GET /api/co-choreographers/{name}/dances (auth-required, case-insensitive, newest-first). All 30 tests PASSED. Test dances are created via /api/dances with a TEST_SOLO_<epoch>_ prefix and deleted in module teardown — verified 0 leftover rows after the run.
critical_code_review_comments: services/choreographer_follows.py: `_SPLIT_RE` correctly avoids hyphen/dot/paren splits — verified against 'A.T. Kinson', 'Rachael McEnaney-White', 'Adrian Lefebour (AUS)'.
routes/dances.py: PUT /dances/{id} calls inject_choreographer_key on the incoming payload — the choreographer_key and co_choreographers stay in sync with a changed choreographer string.
services/bootstepper.py::_normalise correctly pulls the FIRST danceChoreographers[] entry as main and the rest as co, with case-insensitive dedupe.

routes/choreographer_follows.py: GET /co-choreographers/{name:path}/dances is auth-gated via get_current_user dep. Matches on choreographer_key (main) OR co_choreographers ($in candidate spellings) — correctly returns dances where the person is main OR co.
core/serialize.py::dance_to_out: co_choreographers is ALWAYS emitted as a list (defaults to []) — verified for both solo and multi-name dances.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 test dances per run with TEST_SOLO_<epoch>_ prefix, all deleted in module teardown. Confirmed 0 leftovers after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The parser lives in services/choreographer_follows.py::split_choreographers / parse_main_and_co, and the write-site helper is inject_choreographer_key (trusts explicit co list when caller passes one). The BootStepper normaliser at services/bootstepper.py::_normalise is the ONE upstream that captures the exact multi-name roster via danceChoreographers[]. Test corpus fixture in the pytest file seeds three dances that share a co-choreographer (TEST_CoBob) so the co-endpoint returns dances where the person is main OR co.
rca_of_issue: N/A — new feature validation, no regressions detected.
